$description: BIM RETAIL SELECT AND TECH INDUSTRIAL token category — leasable Key Plans for single-storey commercial development classes where the Tile equals the Floor Plate. Retail Select (RA-1/RB-2/RC-3) covers neighbourhood and strip-mall retail leaseholds; Tech Industrial (TI-1/TI-2/TI-3) covers light-industrial, R&D, and tech-production leaseholds. Areas sourced from Spatial Taxonomy — Key Plans and Tiles V12 (AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf, Collaborators #11, 2025-01-07). Confirmed by tool-floorplate D3 (2026-06-15). IFC anchor: IfcSpace for each leasehold unit.

retail-select.$description: Retail Select Key Plans — single-storey neighbourhood retail leaseholds. Tile = Floor Plate (no building core deduction). Three sizes (RA-1 Small / RB-2 Medium / RC-3 Large) assembled from fixed component blocks: A=1,400 SF / B=1,000 SF / C=700 SF / D=1,100 SF / E=1,200 SF / M=200 SF (mezzanine or mechanical). Development class: single-storey with grade-level access. Source: AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf p.5.

$value.source: AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf p.5 — BUILDING SIZE SMALL 4,500 SF
$value.description: Retail Select — Small. 4,500 SF leasable. Single storey; Tile = Floor Plate (no separate building core). Component blocks: A(1,400) + B(1,000) + C(700) + E(1,200) + M(200). Neighbourhood strip or freestanding retail pad. Maximum fascia frontage to parking lot.
$value.tile_role: standalone — Tile = Floor Plate; no building core deduction
$value.design_notes: Smallest Retail Select leasehold. Can add B and D blocks to expand to Medium (6,700 SF). Grade-level access with storefront glazing.

small.$description: Retail Select — Small RA-1. 4,500 SF (418.1 m²). Tile = Floor Plate. Blocks: A+B+C+E+M.

$value.source: AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf p.5 — BUILDING SIZE MEDIUM 6,700 SF
$value.description: Retail Select — Medium. 6,700 SF leasable. Single storey; Tile = Floor Plate. Component blocks: A(1,400) + B(1,000) + C(700) + D(1,100) + D(1,100) + E(1,200) + M(200). Adds two D-blocks to Small configuration.
$value.tile_role: standalone — Tile = Floor Plate; no building core deduction
$value.design_notes: Expanded from Small by adding two D-blocks (1,100 SF each). Can add another B-block to reach Large (7,700 SF).

medium.$description: Retail Select — Medium RB-2. 6,700 SF (622.5 m²). Tile = Floor Plate. Blocks: A+B+C+2×D+E+M.

$value.source: AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf p.5 — BUILDING SIZE LARGE 7,700 SF
$value.description: Retail Select — Large. 7,700 SF leasable. Single storey; Tile = Floor Plate. Component blocks: A(1,400) + B(1,000) + B(1,000) + C(700) + D(1,100) + D(1,100) + E(1,200) + M(200). Adds second B-block to Medium configuration.
$value.tile_role: standalone — Tile = Floor Plate; no building core deduction
$value.design_notes: Largest Retail Select leasehold. Further expansion possible by adding B or D blocks per PDF note 'CAN ADD MORE B AND D TO MAKE BUILDING BIGGER'.

large.$description: Retail Select — Large RC-3. 7,700 SF (715.3 m²). Tile = Floor Plate. Blocks: A+2×B+C+2×D+E+M.

tech-industrial.$description: Tech Industrial Key Plans — single-storey light-industrial, R&D, and tech-production leaseholds. Tile = Floor Plate (no building core deduction). Three sizes (TI-1 Medium / TI-2 Large / TI-3 Extra Large) assembled from fixed component blocks: A=2,200 SF / B=2,100 SF / C=1,200 SF (repeatable) / D=1,500 SF / M=200 SF. Development class: single-storey grade-level industrial with service access. Source: AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf p.6.

$value.source: AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf p.6 — BUILDING SIZE MEDIUM 7,200 SF
$value.description: Tech Industrial — Medium. 7,200 SF leasable. Single storey; Tile = Floor Plate. Component blocks: A(2,200) + B(2,100) + C(1,200) + D(1,500) + M(200). Light industrial, R&D, or tech-production use. Grade-level service door. High clear height (20'–24' typical).
$value.tile_role: standalone — Tile = Floor Plate; no building core deduction
$value.design_notes: Base Tech Industrial unit. Add C-blocks (1,200 SF each) to expand to Large or Extra Large.

medium.$description: Tech Industrial — Medium TI-1. 7,200 SF (669.0 m²). Tile = Floor Plate. Blocks: A+B+C+D+M.
